description: This file defines the EncryptedPayload class, which extends PurePayload and implements EncryptedPayloadInterface. It manages encrypted payload data, including properties like content, encryption keys, and decryption status. It provides methods for creating modified copies and exporting payload data.

classes.name: EncryptedPayload
classes.description: Class representing an encrypted payload, extending PurePayload and implementing encryption-specific behavior.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of EncryptedPayload with raw payload data and optional source.

methods.name: ejected
methods.description: Exports the payload data as an EncryptedTransferPayload object.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the payload, optionally overriding parts of it.

methods.name: copyAsSyncResolved
methods.description: Creates a copy of the payload as a SyncResolvedPayload, with optional overrides.

ctags.name: EncryptedPayload
ctags.pattern: /^export class EncryptedPayload extends PurePayload<EncryptedTransferPayload> implements Encrypted/
